messages:
Maya: heads up — we saw a latency spike on routing tests after the cache-ttl bump landed this morning. Not widespread but reproducible in eu-west pools.
Kevin: saw that too, noticed increased 95th for short requests. Any idea if prefix cache invalidation ran?
Jules: looked at the audit logs — config apply succeeded but there were 409s from the config-service to shard-manager around the same time.
Tiago: 409s usually mean etag mismatch. Could be two concurrent rollouts stomping each other.
Maya: hmm we did have overlapping pushes: console rollout + infra-job that reconciles TTLs.
Kevin: quick question — is the console apply synchronous for propagation or async? I thought we switched to async last year.
Jules: console enqueues a propagation job and returns. The job fanouts to n shards with backoff. If a subsequent write arrives with a different version the shard may reject with 409 and skip TTL update.
Sam: so some shards kept old TTL (longer) and others applied new shorter TTL? that mismatch could cause cache-miss storms -> latency.
Maya: exactly. The router was hit with hot prefixes that suddenly had inconsistent KV states.
Tiago: We should add a short, automated quiesce window on rollout: after config apply, block traffic routing changes for Xs until propagation confirmed.
Kevin: blocking routing changes is risky. Can we do dry-run + shadow propagation first and only promote when telemetry shows uniformity?
Jules: doable — two-step rollout: 1) apply as shadow (no activation), 2) verify propagation (telemetry heartbeat + per-shard version), 3) flip active flag.
Sam: how expensive is per-shard version reporting? We already emit health pings. We could piggyback a small metric: prefix_ttl_v{shard_id, version}.
Maya: love the metric idea. Add a gauge and an expvar for last_applied_version. Then console can read percent of shards at version V.
Tiago: UX question — in the console rollout modal, show percent propagated and a recommended wait time. If propagation stalls, auto-abort and surface logs.
Kevin: ops needs a fallback: if we detect mismatch > 20% for 10m, auto-roll back to previous version and alert oncall.
Jules: agree. Also need an idempotent apply API — include client-side monotonic apply_id so retries don't create new versions. Right now two clients can create two distinct versions which triggers 409 loops.
Sam: patch proposal: add apply_id string to /config/apply and treat identical apply_id as re-apply. Console will generate uuid per user action.
Maya: what about dry-run? We should expose a ?dry_run=true to do shadow propagation but not increment active_version. Useful for smoke checks.
Tiago: telemetry plan: emit propagation_percent, propagation_latency_p50/p95, and mismatch_error_count. Hook alerts if propagation_percent < 90 after 5m.
Deploy-Bot: deploy queued: config-service v2.3.1 (propagation-metrics) -> staging at 1718510100.
Kevin: also add guardrail config in runtime: if propagation_percent < threshold, router stays on previous behavior. That avoids sudden user-facing changes.
Jules: for the console, add a small UI change: disable "Apply" button until user acknowledges potential overlap with other active rollouts in the same scope. Show active rollouts list.
Maya: rollout checklist: (1) API change apply_id + dry_run, (2) propagation metrics, (3) console percent UI + confirmation, (4) automatic rollback policy, (5) oncall runbook update.
Sam: I'll open a PR for the metrics + API change. Tiago can you draft the console UX copy for the percent/confirm?
Tiago: will do, posting mock in #design this afternoon.
Maya: ops-bot — can you schedule a canary rollout of the new apply flow to 5% of configs in staging tomorrow 09:00 UTC?
ops-bot: scheduled canary: config-propagation-v2 -> staging -> cohorts: 5% at 1718593200.
Kevin: one more nit — add a reconciler job that periodically checks shard versions and attempts idempotent heals if a shard lags behind for > 30m. But must be backoff-safe.
Jules: agreed, and make reconciler run in a maintenance window by default. We don't want it competing with live rollouts.
Maya: ok team, action items summed: Sam PR for API+metrics, Tiago console copy + mock, Jules reconciler design + rollback automation, Kevin telemetry alerts, Maya update runbook. We'll reconvene after canary. :thumbsup:
